current_project.name: agent-craft-ai-skill-hub
current_project.title: AgentCraft: AI Skill Hub
current_project.description: A collaborative web platform for crafting, organizing, and sharing AI agent skills, prompts, and complex agentic workflows. It empowers teams to build a structured knowledge base of effective AI interactions, fostering reusability and accelerating agent development.
features: Create and manage AI 'skills' (prompts, agent configurations, code snippets)
Tagging and categorization for easy discovery
User profiles and basic collaboration spaces

tasks.name: Project Setup & Base Styling
tasks.description: Scaffold Vite+React+TS project, configure Tailwind CSS, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, and Netlify deployment. Set up base `App.tsx` and global `index.css`.

tasks.name: Core Layout & Navigation
tasks.description: Implement a responsive web layout including a header, sidebar, and main content area. Set up React Router v6 for key routes: Home, Skills List, Skill Detail, and New Skill.

tasks.name: Zustand Store & Mock Data
tasks.description: Define the `Skill` and `User` TypeScript interfaces. Set up a Zustand store to manage application state (skills, current user). Populate the store with mock skill data for development.

tasks.name: Skills List & Search/Filter
tasks.description: Develop the `SkillsListPage` to display a list of skills from the Zustand store. Implement a search bar and a basic tag filtering UI and logic using `lucide-react` for icons.

tasks.name: Skill Detail View
tasks.description: Create the `SkillDetailPage` to display comprehensive information for a single skill, fetched by its ID. Utilize `react-markdown` to render skill descriptions formatted in Markdown.

tasks.name: Create New Skill Form
tasks.description: Build the `NewSkillPage` with a form for users to add new AI skills. Include inputs for skill name, prompt, description (with a Markdown editor), and a multi-select/chip input for tags. Integrate with Zustand to save new skills.

tasks.name: Edit Skill Functionality
tasks.description: Extend the `SkillForm` to support editing existing skills. Implement an 'Edit' button on the `SkillDetailPage` that navigates to an `EditSkillPage`, pre-populating the form with the skill's current data for updates in Zustand.

tasks.name: User Profiles & Basic Sharing
tasks.description: Mock a `currentUser` in a dedicated Zustand store. Display basic user information in the header/sidebar. Add a conceptual 'Public/Private' toggle to skill forms to indicate sharing status (frontend-only).

tasks.name: Enhanced UI & Interaction
tasks.description: Integrate `react-hot-toast` for user feedback (success/error messages). Enhance UI with subtle animations/transitions and use `date-fns` for consistent date formatting across skill cards and detail pages.

tasks.name: Testing & Final Polish
tasks.description: Write unit and integration tests for key components and Zustand store actions using Vitest and React Testing Library. Conduct a final review of responsiveness, accessibility, and overall styling. Prepare `public` assets and finalize `netlify.toml`.
